issues: Header links are not accessible as the test expects a link with name "Book a consultation" but the component renders a <button> with that text; change the header CTA to a <Link> element with role="link" and appropriate href="/contact".
Footer navigation links are hidden with aria-hidden="true" and tabIndex={-1}, causing the test to not find them; remove aria-hidden and tabIndex so the links are visible and focusable.
Contact page label for Name is missing htmlFor attribute, causing the test to not find a label with the text "Name"; add htmlFor="name" to the label or wrap the input correctly.

Contact page renders the thank-you message inside a new <section> without preserving the form fields; the test expects the form fields to be cleared after submission and no network request; ensure the form fields are reset and fetch is not called.

Home page generates two "Book a consultation" links (one button rendered as <button> and one link) causing duplicate link errors; consolidate to a single <Link> element for both CTA buttons where appropriate.
feedback: Several UI components do not match the expected accessible elements and labels, leading to failing acceptance tests. Adjust the Header to use a link for the consultation CTA, expose Footer links, fix label associations in Contact, ensure form reset after submit, and avoid duplicate Book a consultation links on the Home page.
